findings.issue: IS_CONTIGUOUS p3 mixed a type admission with restrictions, and the 'any type' plan claimed exhaustiveness while omitting complex
findings.resolution: split into a permission and restrictions; the plan covers every intrinsic type and a derived type, with whole-array .TRUE. against a non-contiguous section .FALSE.

findings.issue: SELECTED_INT_KIND(18) was claimed to be possibly negative
findings.resolution: coordinator overruled: 7.4.3.1 p2 'The processor shall provide at least one representation method with a decimal exponent range greater than or equal to 18', so the kind is guaranteed; the plans cite it
